He further submits that the suit property were vested absolutely in the hand of the Government as "forest land" by a gazette notification No. 1139 dated 14-11-51 after serving the notice upon the Zaminder on 11-8-1951 and the local people on 11-8-1951; that moreover, the SA khatian and RS khatian were correctly prepared in the name of the Government and the Forest Department; that the suit property cannot be settled by anyone to anybody; that the plaintiff of the present suit was not made party as defendant in the earlier title suit No. 329 of 1974; that the present defendant as plaintiffs collusively made wrong persons as defendants in that earlier suit and that managed false signatures in summons notice and collusively obtained fraudulent decree suppressing summons. He further submits that the plaintiff came to know about the ex parte decree of earlier suit after getting notice against the Miscellaneous Case No. 4 of 1988 in the Court of the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) on 5-7-1988; that no pattan was given by Zaminder to Abdul Gafur and that the rent receipts and khatians were manufactured and that the finding and decision both are erroneous in law as well as on fact, as such, the same is liable to be set aside.
